name: Application Registry — OCI Manifest, Media Types & Registry API Surface
description: Verifies a real Application Registry serves the Application Package as a spec-conformant OCI artifact and speaks the standard OCI Registry API (tags, manifests, blobs). Runs `oras manifest fetch` / `oras blob fetch` / `oras repo tags` / a raw v2 tags-list GET against REGISTRY_REF (env var, or set `oras.ref` per step) — no mocking, no signing, no mTLS (the Application Registry is a plain OCI registry, unrelated to the WFM management-interface auth model). One test case per CR-ID; verdict logic reuses the same validate() operators as every other wfm-supplier check.

steps.name: Manifest artifactType marks this as a Margo Application Package
config object is the OCI empty-config descriptor
The manifest as a whole is a valid OCI Image Manifest (schemaVersion 2, correct manifest mediaType)
The Application Description is present as a manifest layer
Every layer the package ships carries a Margo-specific media type, never a generic one (e.g. application/octet-stream)
Retrieving the Application Package Manifest works via the standard OCI 'pull manifest' pattern
Retrieving each Application Package part works via the standard OCI 'pull blob' pattern, not a custom download mechanism
The registry lists at least one published tag/version for this Application Package
The raw tags-list response is the exact {name, tags[]} JSON shape the OCI Distribution Spec defines
The full OCI Registry API surface (tags, manifest, blobs) is usable end to end, not a partial/bespoke subset

name: MIAF Identity — Trust Bundle Fetch and mTLS Handshake
description: The mTLS handshake: the WFM presents an SVID that chains to the MIS CA and carries the SPIFFE ID of the WFM this client belongs to, and accepts the CTT's client SVID; it refuses a connection without a client certificate and one with a certificate the MIS did not issue.

name: MIAF Identity — SVID Rotation Continuity
description: Verifies that after SVID rotation the WFM continues to accept the client without re-registration: a request with the pre-rotation SVID and a request with the re-issued SVID (same SPIFFE ID) must both succeed. Runs only once the CTT's client SVID has been re-issued and installed again through Setup MIAF Identity, which keeps the SVID it replaces; until then both steps are reported as NOT RUN.
